Bob.true:

"You're 14 now, and you need to start pulling your own weight.
"We're just about to make another run to the old city, and [url=0]you're coming with us.[/url]"

Bob_items.title: Tutorial - Items
Bob_items.true:
"To equip your weapon, first press TAB to access the menu.
Under Inventory menu, click on the weapon slot and move it to the corresponding equipment slot above.

Once outside the menu, you can swap between the 4 weapon slots using the number keys for fast weapon swapping."

[i][url=0]> Ok[/url][/i]

Bob_combat.title: Tutorial - Combat
Bob_combat.true:
"Press TAB and go to your Skills menu.
The icons at the top part of the menu are your currently equipped skills. Moving a skill from the bottom part to the top equips them.
When in combat, you will use the equipped skills in their respective order."

[i][url=0]> Alrighty[/url][/i]

Bob_runs.title: Tutorial - Runs
Bob_runs.true:
"Gardening is ok, but at the end of the day, it's the canned goodiness that feed us.

When we get to our destination, just follow us and stay out of harm's way. [url=0]Understand?[/url]"
